feeds.title: The Reunion Church
feeds.description: Dr. Steve Isaac was convinced that Christians need the immediacy of encouragement and strengthening through walking in close relationships with other believers. In the summer of 1999, Pastor Steve and a group of friends met in a local park to worship and pray together. The Reunion Church is a flourishing community of faith called to love God, teach His truth, and care for one another in fellowship, communion, and prayer.If you are searching Bible-teaching churches near me, follow the church for news about The Reunion Church.
